meta.name: firebase-hosting-basics
meta.description: Deploys and configures classic Firebase Hosting for static websites, single-page apps (SPAs), and microservices. Use when deploying static sites/SPAs, setting up custom domains, configuring firebase.json hosting settings (redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site), or managing preview channels. Don't use for Firebase App Hosting (Next.js/SSR), Auth, Firestore queries/rules, Data Connect, or Crashlytics.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把静态网站或单页应用部署到 Firebase Hosting:修改 firebase.json 里的公开目录、重定向、重写、headers、多站点设置,并用预览频道测试后再发布上线。
howto.when: 当你要部署静态站点或 SPA、配置自定义域名与 firebase.json 托管设置、管理预览频道等场景时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: Claude deploys your static site or SPA to Firebase Hosting: it edits firebase.json (public directory, redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site) and manages preview channels and releases.
howto.when_en: Use it when deploying a static site or SPA, setting up custom domains or firebase.json hosting settings, or managing preview channels.
